summary: PepsiCo, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting the completion of an ordinary investment-grade debt offering, not a special situation. On October 9, 2026, the company announced €500 million of 3.750% Senior Notes due 2029 and €500 million of 4.250% Senior Notes due 2035. Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch and HSBC Bank plc acted as joint book-running managers. Net proceeds are described as approximately received for general corporate purposes. The filing is a routine senior notes takedown rather than any acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or capital-return event; no deal-arb angle applies.
